profile.dividendPolicy: The Company will consider the ability to pay dividends according to legal requirements, inclduing the Public Limited Companies Act B.E. 2535 (and its amendments) that states that dividend payments from sources other than profits cannot be made and in cases where the Company still has accumulated losses, dividend payments are prohibited. The Company has a dividend policy to pay dividends at a rate of not less than 35 percent of net profit from the separate financial statements after deducting corporate income tax and various reserves as stipulated by relevant laws and Articles of Association of the Company. However, the Company may consider setting the dividend payment schedule and rate differently, taking into account factors such as operational performance, cash flows, financial condition, investment plans, the necessity of using funds as working capital for business operations and business expansion, economic conditions, debt repayment plans, and other factors as deemed appropriate by the board of directors. Nevertheless, the aforementioned dividend payments may be subject to changes depending on necessity and appropriateness as determined by the board of directors. In this regard, the annual dividend payment must be approved by the shareholders' meeting, unless it is an interim dividend payment, in which the board of directors has the authority to approve interim dividend payments from time to time provided that the Company has sufficient profits to do so. The board of directors will report such dividend payments to the shareholders for their acknowledgement at the next meeting.
